data.name: Emmanita
data.long_meaning: Emmanita is a Hebrew name derived from the Hebrew word 'emmanah', meaning 'God is gracious'. It was a name given to a girl in the Old Testament who was the wife of Isaiah, a prophet. In the New Testament, Emmanu-El (God with us) is a title given to Jesus Christ, which emphasizes God's presence and grace with humanity.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes God's gracious presence and love in one's life.
data.numerology_meaning: Emmanita is a name that resonates with the number 3, which is associated with creativity, self-expression, and communication. This suggests that individuals with this name have a natural ability to bring beauty and joy into the world through their words and actions.

in_hebrew.name: עמניטה
in_hebrew.long_meaning: השם עמניטה נגזר מהמילה העברית 'עמנו', שפירושה 'אלוהים עמנו'. זהו שם שמשקף את ההבטחה האלוהית לנוכחות ולקרבה של אלוהים עם המאמינים. השם מופיע בספר ישעיהו (ישעיהו 7:14, 8:8) ומתייחס לנבואה על בואו של ישו המשיח, שיהיה אמיל (עמנו) - אלוהים עמנו.

in_greek.name: Εμμανίτα
in_greek.meaning: Ο Θεός μεθ' ημών, υπόσχεση θεϊκή παρουσίας
in_greek.long_meaning: Το όνομα Εμμανίτα προέρχεται από την ελληνική μετάφραση της λέξης 'Εμμανουήλ', που σημαίνει 'Ο Θεός μεθ' ημών'. Αυτό το όνομα αντανακλά την υπόσχεση του Θεού για την παρουσία και την εγγύτητα του Θεού με τους πιστούς. Στην Καινή Διαθήκη, το όνομα σχετίζεται με την προφητεία για την έλευση του Ιησού Χριστού, που θα είναι ο Εμμανουήλ, δηλαδή 'Ο Θεός μεθ' ημών'.

in_latin.name: Emmanita
in_latin.long_meaning: Nomen Emmanita derivatur ex voce Latina 'Emmanuel', quae significat 'Deus nobiscum'. Hoc nomen reflectit promissionem divinam praesentiae et propinquitatis Dei cum fidelibus. In Scriptura Sacra, nomen hoc refertur ad prophetiam de adventu Iesu Christi, qui erit Emmanuel, id est 'Deus nobiscum'.

in_english.name: Emmanita
in_english.meaning: God is with us, divine promise of presence
in_english.long_meaning: The name Emmanita originates from the Hebrew 'Immanuel', meaning 'God is with us'. It reflects the divine promise of God's presence and closeness to believers. This name is biblically significant, appearing in Isaiah (Isaiah 7:14, 8:8) and referring to the prophecy of Jesus Christ's coming as Emmanuel, signifying God's presence among humanity. The name Emmanita symbolizes spiritual connection, divine guidance, and reassurance of God's constant presence.
